pages.title: Light blue · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday evening in a small apartment in Portland. Bea looks at her bedroom walls and sighs. The old yellow paint is dull and has marks. She calls her friend Kai, who loves home projects. He answers with a cheerful voice. They start to make a plan.
“Bea, let’s paint your room this weekend.” says Kai. “Great idea! What color should we choose?” says Bea. “Let’s try light blue. It is calm and bright.” says Kai.

pages.title: Light blue · 3/3
paragraphs: “Good. What time should we start?” says Bea. “Let’s start at nine on Saturday morning.” says Kai. On Saturday, Bea and Kai move the bed and the desk. They cover the floor with plastic and tape the edges. Kai paints the top and Bea paints the bottom. By afternoon, the room is soft blue and fresh. They eat pizza on the floor and admire their work. Fresh paint can make a room feel new.
